name: oracle-error-help
description: Explain Oracle errors from official documentation and maintain trusted lookup references locally.

interface.shortDescription: Explain and maintain Oracle error references.
interface.longDescription: Runs implicitly during LLM sessions to look up recognized Oracle errors in official Error Help. Its dependency-free local reference editor starts only when requested.
defaultPrompt: Explain this Oracle error and suggest the next action.
Open the Oracle Error Help reference editor.
